slot_scores.name: no_borrowing_cash_only
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there any constraint that the total amount invested at the beginning of a year cannot exceed the cash available at that moment (i.e., no borrowing or leverage allowed)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether borrowing/leverage is allowed and whether investments are limited to cash available at that moment, directly covering the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden P1 slot, no borrowing/cash-only constraint, was explicitly asked and confirmed before READY_TO_MODEL. No unresolved P0 or P1 slots remained.

summary: The agent asked targeted clarification questions and explicitly resolved the key hidden no-borrowing/cash-only constraint before modeling. The interaction stopped appropriately with no unresolved P0/P1 hidden slots.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
